title: Vector spaces and subspaces: the axioms that make linear combinations work
objectives: State the vector space axioms and derive their basic consequences
Verify or refute that a set with two operations is a vector space
Apply the one-step subspace test to null spaces, spans, intersections and sums
Decide when a union or a sum of subspaces is a subspace or a direct sum
prerequisites: Chapters 1 and 2: fields, row reduction and solution sets.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 4 and 5 were read in full; the running matrix, the boundary examples, several proofs and the exercises are original.
